acclimatization.climate.humidity.hint: Size of humidity zones in blocks: regions that are wet or dry overall. Vanilla Minecraft's are about %s blocks. Inside them, individual biomes keep the size set by Biome size, so a dry zone can still have some forest.
acclimatization.climate.biome_size.hint: Size of individual biomes compared with vanilla Minecraft: how big humidity and temperature patches are inside each zone. Terrain (hills, mountains, coasts) is left to the world type or your terrain mod.
acclimatization.climate.zone.hot.hint: Width in blocks, from the equator. The hot band around the equator is twice this wide.
acclimatization.climate.zone.warm.hint: Width in blocks. Savannas, jungles and warm forests.
acclimatization.climate.zone.temperate.h: Width in blocks. Plains and forests.
acclimatization.climate.zone.cold.hint: Width in blocks. Taiga and spruce forests.
acclimatization.climate.zone.frozen.hint: Width in blocks, from the edge of the frozen zone to the pole. Where the zones repeat past the pole, the polar band is twice this wide.
acclimatization.climate.zones_summary: Frozen zone starts %s blocks from the equator; pole at %s.
acclimatization.climate.beyond.blocks: %s is past the recommended %s to %s blocks.
acclimatization.climate.beyond_elsewhere: A setting on the other page is past its recommended range.
acclimatization.climate.unsupported: Unsupported: may cause performance or compatibility issues.
acclimatization.climate.waviness.hint: How wavy the borders between temperature zones are. 0% keeps them perfectly straight (biomes still mix a little right along them); higher values make the bands meander north and south more and more, like real climate zones. 100% is the default.
acclimatization.climate.deviation_temper: Biome Temperature Zone Deviation: how many temperature zones (hot, warm, temperate, cold, frozen) a deviation patch can jump, colder or warmer. At 2 a hot desert can turn up in a temperate area; at 4 or 5 a snowy patch can turn up in the tropics. Bigger jumps are rarer than small ones. 0 turns temperature jumps off. Default 1.
acclimatization.climate.deviation_humidi: Biome Humidity Zone Deviation: how many humidity bands (Minecraft has five, arid to humid) a deviation patch can jump, drier or wetter, like a rain-shadow desert in jungle country or a wet pocket in dry land. 0 turns humidity jumps off. Default 1.
acclimatization.climate.deviation_size.h: The typical width of a deviation patch in blocks; each is between about 0.7 and 1.3 times this, with ragged edges. Default 3,000, which at the default zone sizes is about the size of real-world climate oddities like the Atacama or Namib deserts.
acclimatization.climate.deviation_freque: How much of the world lies in deviation patches. 0% turns them off. Default 5%, roughly how much of real land has a climate out of step with its latitude (cold deserts, rain shadows, cool coasts). Above about 20% patches start to overlap.
acclimatization.climate.desert_share.hin: Roughly how much of the hot zone is desert; the rest is savanna, forest and jungle. Default 45%. 50% gives deserts and wet land in equal measure. How big each desert is follows the humidity zone size on the Zones page.
acclimatization.climate.deviation.summar: Patches where the climate jumps zones, like a snowy forest beside a desert.
acclimatization.climate.page.zones.hint: Temperature zone widths, humidity zone size, biome size and band waviness.
acclimatization.climate.page.deviation.h: Climate deviation patches, where the climate jumps warmer, colder, drier or wetter, and how much of the hot zone is desert.
acclimatization.climate.title: Climate
acclimatization.world.toggle.hint: Climate zones follow latitude: hot at the equator (z = 0), colder going north and south, up to frozen poles. Works with any world type and only changes the overworld.
acclimatization.world.settings.hint: Zone widths, humidity zone size, biome size, band waviness and climate deviation.
acclimatization.world.own_climate: This world type has its own climate settings (Landmass or Trini's Terrain), so Custom Climate is not used for it.
